1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralAngles
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralAngleIncidence

6 /-! Strict positivity of curvature at every genuine vertex of the four canonical surfaces. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
9 
10 open OctahedralTriangles
11 
12 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
13 
14 /-- The incident triangle angles are precisely the four successive angles of the cyclic fan. -/
15 theorem totalAngleAt_eq_fan_angles (v : Fin 6) : graph.totalAngleAt v =
16     ∑ i : Fin 4, EuclideanGeometry.angle (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor v i) : Space)
17       (graph.vertex v : Space) (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor v (i + 1)) : Space) := by
18   exact angle_incidence
19     (fun a b c => EuclideanGeometry.angle (graph.vertex a : Space) (graph.vertex b : Space) (graph.vertex c : Space))
20     (fun a b c => EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm _ _ _) v
21 
22 /-- Cutting rays by a positive transverse height preserves each incident spatial angle. -/
23 theorem fanRay_angle (v : Fin 6) (figure : P.VertexFigure (graph.vertex v)) (i : Fin 4) :
24     InnerProductGeometry.angle (graph.fanRay v figure i) (graph.fanRay v figure (i + 1)) =
25       EuclideanGeometry.angle (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor v i) : Space)
26         (graph.vertex v : Space) (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor v (i + 1)) : Space) := by
27   have first := figure.gap_pos (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor v i)).property (graph.fan_neighbor_distinct v i)
28   have second := figure.gap_pos (graph.vertex (fanNeighbor v (i + 1))).property
29     (graph.fan_neighbor_distinct v (i + 1))
30   rw [fanRay, fanRay, VertexFigure.direction, VertexFigure.direction,
31     InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ (inv_pos.mpr first),
32     InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_right_of_pos _ _ (inv_pos.mpr second)]
33   rfl
34 
35 /-- Convex supporting facets make the actual incident angle sum strictly less than a full turn. -/
36 theorem totalAngleAt_lt_two_pi
37     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
38       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) (v : Fin 6) :
39     graph.totalAngleAt v < 2 * Real.pi := by
40   obtain ⟨normal, strict⟩ := P.vertex_strict_support (graph.vertex v).property
41   let figure : P.VertexFigure (graph.vertex v) := ⟨normal, strict⟩
42   have bound := (graph.vertexFan v figure small_faces).sum_angles_lt_two_pi
43   have angles : graph.totalAngleAt v = ∑ i : Fin 4,
44       InnerProductGeometry.angle ((graph.vertexFan v figure small_faces).ray i)
45         ((graph.vertexFan v figure small_faces).ray (i + 1)) := by
46     rw [graph.totalAngleAt_eq_fan_angles]
47     apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
48     intro i member
49     rw [graph.vertexFan_ray, graph.vertexFan_ray, graph.fanRay_angle]
50   rwa [← angles] at bound
51 
52 /-- Every genuine vertex has strictly positive curvature, even with flat auxiliary hinges. -/
53 theorem curvature_pos
54     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
55       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) (v : Fin 6) : 0 < graph.curvature v := by
56   have bound := graph.totalAngleAt_lt_two_pi small_faces v
57   unfold curvature
58   linarith
59 
60 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
